issue.title: Update Cybersecurity Infrastructure service list from SECASSURED source

affected_files.role: Defines the Category taxonomy; the 'Related Infrastructure Categories' block (5G Core, 5G RAN, User Equipment, Attack Emulation, Healthcare Equipment, Virtualization, Network Simulation, Monitoring, Security Tools, Testing Tools) is the best code-level match for 'Cybersecurity Infrastructure service' categories
match_reasons: flagged by triage.json as issue #6's primary file

affected_files.role: Mongoose schema for Category (name, slug, description); no field distinguishes toolbox vs infrastructure categories today — that grouping exists only as a source comment
The infrastructureServices array references categorySlug values defined in categories.seed.ts; any rename/removal there must be reconciled here or seeding fails silently
IService.categoryId is the join point between services and categories; repositoryTable enum distinguishes INTACT_TOOLBOX vs OTHER_SERVICES
Seeds NIS2 sectors used via Service.sectorId; separate taxonomy cross-referenced by the category-to-sector migration
Hard-coded categoryToSectorMapping keyed by every current category slug; a #6 refresh that adds/removes/renames categories will silently desync this mapping
GET /api/categories — simple list endpoint, no filtering/grouping logic to change
OpenAPI spec references categoryId generically; no enumerated category list to update
Mentions Infrastructure.ts/infrastructures.ts in an architecture listing; no enumerated category list
Documents the 'categories' collection generically; would need updating if category shape/values change materially
Renders a category filter sourced from GET /api/categories dynamically; no hardcoded list, so no client change needed for a pure data refresh

analysis.summary: 'Cybersecurity Infrastructure' maps to the 'Related Infrastructure Categories' block inside categories.seed.ts, a pure category-taxonomy list that classifies OTHER_SERVICES entries; the current implementation is a flat, hardcoded array with no distinction field between toolbox and infrastructure categories, and category slugs are referenced by string from services.seed.ts and migrate-category-to-sector.ts with no compile-time check tying them together.
analysis.details: Refreshing this list from SECASSURED is primarily a data edit to categories.seed.ts (add/rename/remove category entries), but any slug change must be propagated to (a) services.seed.ts entries that reference the old categorySlug, and (b) the categoryToSectorMapping table in migrate-category-to-sector.ts, or seeding will silently skip/mis-map affected services. This is lower complexity than #5/#7 because it touches a smaller, self-contained taxonomy list rather than large per-service data records, and the client already consumes categories dynamically with no hardcoded UI list to update.
